insight: Licensed AGPL-3.0; the entire knowledge graph lives in local Markdown files on disk — no proprietary database, Obsidian-compatible.
name: Basic Memory
tagline: Persistent, local knowledge graph for AI tools — stored as plain Markdown.
description: An MCP server that gives AI assistants a durable, local knowledge base built from your conversations, notes, and documents. Everything is written to standard Markdown files you own, indexed by a local SQLite store, and readable/editable in Obsidian. Connects to Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.

modelSupport.notes: MCP server; the connected AI client supplies the model.

edge: Unlike cloud memory stores, your graph stays in editable local Markdown you can open in Obsidian — portable and inspectable, not locked in a DB.
pros: Works across Claude, Cursor, VS Code via MCP
cons: AGPL-3.0 may not suit every team
Cross-device sync is a paid cloud add-on
Setup needs a local CLI install

references.title: Give Claude Permanent Memory with Basic Memory MCP + Obsidian
